verdict.rationale: Plausible offers an Events API for recording pageviews and custom events, plus a Stats API (/api/v2/query) for simple and complex stats queries, so an agent can ingest data and read most dashboard metrics programmatically. However, the Stats API is explicitly read-only. Nothing in the evidence shows API control over the many UI-managed features, such as goals, funnels, annotations, shared links, email/Slack reports, team/site management, imports and exports, and no OpenAPI spec was found. missing for 10: write/management API covering site setup, goals, funnels, annotations, sharing and reports; evidence of UI–API parity; machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI 404).
